g1|variants|down payments.summary: This family covers standard SAP S/4HANA OTC down payment processing variants driven by SD billing plans and FI integration. The variants differ by whether down payments are requested via billing requests, cleared against final invoices automatically or manually, and handled with standard or advanced payment integration.

variants.name: Standard Down Payment Request with Billing Plan
variants.when_used: Used when an upfront payment is required from the customer before goods delivery, controlled via a milestone billing plan in the sales order.
values: OR
2 (Milestone billing)
TAX
FA (Down Payment Request)
A (Down Payment)
variants.key_config: Configure billing plan type in VOV7, assign billing request type FA in VOFA, and map special G/L indicator 'A' in FI-SD integration (OBYC/FBKP).

variants.name: Mandatory Down Payment with Delivery Block
variants.when_used: Used when order fulfillment and outbound delivery are strictly blocked until the customer down payment request is fully paid and cleared.
values: OR
2 (Milestone billing)
TAN
FA (Down Payment Request)
A (Down Payment)
variants.key_config: Set delivery block at sales document header/item level, cleared automatically via SD credit/payment interface when FI posting matches.

variants.name: Percentage-Based Down Payment (Periodic)
variants.when_used: Used for long-running orders or capital goods where a percentage of the total order value is requested as an advance payment prior to shipping.
values: OR
1 (Periodic billing)
TAW
FA (Down Payment Request)
A (Down Payment)
variants.key_config: Configure percentage billing plan rules in Customizing under Sales and Documents > Billing > Billing Plan.

variants.name: Manual Down Payment without Billing Plan
variants.when_used: Used when down payments are agreed outside the sales order lifecycle and entered directly in FI, but need to be manually assigned during SD billing clearance.
values: OR
N/A (No billing plan)
TAN
F2 (Invoice)
A (Down Payment)
variants.key_config: No SD billing plan required; financial down payment is posted directly in FI (F-29) and manually cleared during final invoice creation (VF01/F-32).

g1|panel|down payments.otc_impact: Down payments sit between Order-to-Cash and Financial Accounting by securing customer capital before fulfilling sales orders and deliveries. This process changes sales order creation by introducing billing plans and delivery blocks, ensures correct accounts receivable posting via special G/L indicators, and automates clearing when final billing documents are generated. It protects cash flow and minimizes credit risk for engineered-to-order and high-value capital goods transactions.

panel_qa.question: How do we ensure that outbound deliveries remain strictly blocked until the customer's down payment is fully cleared in Finance?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: This requirement is met by assigning a billing plan type that triggers down payment requests and setting a delivery block at the sales document header level via transaction VOR1 or customizing path Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Credit Management/Risk Management. When the financial posting clears the down payment request in transaction F-29 or FBR1, a payment status update removes the delivery block automatically through standard credit management or event-driven process chains. This guarantees that physical warehouse picking and goods issue never occur without prior financial commitment. The leadership value is eliminated bad debt risk and strict adherence to company credit policy before inventory leaves the warehouse. Next, we should review the automated clearing rules in FI-AR. Trap: We can just trust the sales team to remove the delivery block manually once the customer says they paid.
panel_qa.trap: We can just trust the sales team to remove the delivery block manually once the customer says they paid.

panel_qa.question: Why use a billing plan instead of a manual SD billing document for generating down payment requests?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Billing plans automate the schedule of down payment requests based on dates or milestones defined in customizing path Sales and Distribution > Billing > Billing Plan. Using billing plan types linked to item categories ensures that standard SD billing transaction VF01 generates billing document requests with specific billing types such as FAZ for down payments and FAZ2 for final settlement. This standard approach maintains absolute document traceability from the sales order item to the accounting document, avoiding manual data entry errors. The technical configuration relies on requirement classes and billing relevance setting 'E' for billing plan on the item category. Next, we will configure the milestone percentages for project-based orders. Trap: Manual billing documents are faster to set up because we do not need to configure billing plan types.
panel_qa.trap: Manual billing documents are faster to set up because we do not need to configure billing plan types.

panel_qa.question: How does the final billing document correctly offset the down payment already paid without creating duplicate revenue recognition?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: The system offsets the down payment through statistical billing items and special G/L integration in pricing procedure RVAA01 using condition types such as AZWR for down payment clearing. When creating the final invoice in transaction VF01, the billing type F2 automatically pulls open down payment items referenced from the preceding billing plan or sales order. Accounting document posting clears the special G/L account (target reconciliation account) and posts net revenue to the standard revenue account. This ensures compliance with IFRS 15 regarding contract liabilities and prevents inflated revenue reporting. Next, we will audit the condition exclusion groups for down payment clearing types. Trap: We should post the down payment as a standard credit memo to reduce the final invoice value.
panel_qa.trap: We should post the down payment as a standard credit memo to reduce the final invoice value.

avoid_issues.issue: Deliveries are created despite the customer having an outstanding unpaid down payment request.
avoid_issues.avoid: Assign the delivery block field in the sales document header configuration and link the billing plan milestone status to credit management.

avoid_issues.issue: Final billing document does not clear the down payment, leaving an open residual balance on the customer account.
avoid_issues.avoid: Include condition type AZWR with requirement 051 in the pricing procedure and ensure billing type settings reference the correct down payment request.

avoid_issues.issue: Special G/L transaction figures do not flow correctly to the general ledger upon down payment receipt.
avoid_issues.avoid: Verify that the account determination in transaction VKOA maps sales organization, account assignment group, and account key to the correct special G/L reconciliation account.

errors.title: Delivery Block Due to Missing Down Payment
errors.message_text: Delivery block & because down payment not yet received
errors.plain_meaning: The warehouse cannot pack or ship the goods because the customer has not paid the mandatory advance money yet.
errors.cause: The billing plan milestone for the down payment request has not been billed or the incoming payment has not been cleared against Special G/L indicator A, leaving the delivery block active on sales order type OR.
errors.config_step: Define Delivery Block Reasons in SPRO and assign to Sales Document Type OR
errors.verify: Re-run VL01N; the delivery block must be automatically removed upon payment clearing and the delivery creation must proceed without error.
errors.prevent: Implement automated payment integration via SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity or lock manual delivery override permissions.
errors.ref_title: SD Billing Plan and Down Payment Processing

errors.title: Billing Plan Missing for Milestone Down Payment
errors.message_text: No billing plan exists for item &
errors.plain_meaning: The system does not know when to ask for the advance payment because the payment schedule is not attached to the item.
errors.cause: Item category TAN is not assigned to billing plan type 2 (Milestone billing) in Customizing, or the copy control from sales document type OR is missing the billing plan transfer routine.
errors.config_step: Assign Billing Plan Type 2 to Item Category TAN in SPRO
errors.verify: Create a new sales order via VA01 using sales doc type OR and item category TAN; open item details and confirm the Billing Plan tab automatically populates with milestone type 2.
errors.prevent: Ensure baseline SAP Best Practices scope items for down payments are fully activated via SAP Solution Builder.

fix_steps.step: Configure item category assignment for billing plan

fix_steps.values: Check billing plan type assignment for TAN

errors.title: Incorrect Special G/L Indicator for Down Payment Request
errors.message_text: Special G/L indicator A is not defined for account type D
errors.plain_meaning: Financial Accounting rejects the billing document because it does not recognize the special code used for customer advance payments.
errors.cause: Billing type FA is mapped to a posting routine or account determination that lacks Special G/L indicator A configuration in Financial Accounting (FI).
errors.config_step: Define Special G/L Indicator A for Customer Down Payments in FI Customizing
errors.verify: Re-create billing document FA via VF01; accounting document must generate with reconciliation account pointing to down payments received.
errors.prevent: Always coordinate SD billing type configuration with FI finance consultants during financial data setups.
errors.ref_title: Special G/L Transactions in Accounts Receivable

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Financial Accounting -> Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable -> Business Transactions -> Customer Down Payments -> Define Alternative Reconciliation Account for Down Payments

fix_steps.values: Billing type FA -> Account determination procedure

errors.title: Down Payment Request Billing Type Missing
errors.message_text: Billing type FA is not defined
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot generate the advance payment invoice because the specific invoice template does not exist.
errors.cause: Standard billing type FA (Down Payment Request) has been deleted or not copied into the client from delivery template client 000.
errors.verify: Execute VF01 with billing type FA and sales order reference; document selection list should open successfully.
errors.prevent: Lock customizing client transport routes to prevent accidental deletion of standard SAP delivery types.

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Billing -> Billing Documents -> Define Billing Types
fix_steps.values: Copy from standard template FA or create new with cancellation billing type S1

errors.title: Incomplete Copy Control for Down Payment Request
errors.message_text: Copy control for billing document from sales document OR to FA does not exist
errors.plain_meaning: The system is blocked from copying sales order data into the down payment invoice because the bridge rules are missing.
errors.cause: Copy control table TVCPF is missing the entry linking sales document type OR and billing type FA at the item level.
errors.config_step: Maintain Copy Control for Billing Documents (Sales Document to Billing Document)
errors.verify: Re-attempt billing creation in VF01; system should successfully transfer pricing and billing plan dates from sales order OR to billing document FA.
errors.prevent: Include copy control transports in all release migration checklists for order-to-cash implementations.
errors.ref_title: Copy Control in Sales and Distribution

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Billing -> Billing Documents -> Maintain Copy Control for Billing Documents -> Copy Control: Sales Document to Billing Document
fix_steps.values: Source: OR, Target: FA, Item category: TAN, Data transfer routine: 019 (Billing plan)

errors.title: Clearing Error Between Down Payment and Final Invoice
errors.message_text: Down payment clearing item missing or cannot be determined
errors.plain_meaning: The final customer invoice cannot deduct the advance payment that the customer already paid.
errors.cause: The billing item category configuration lacks the down payment clearing indicator, or the down payment request was never cleared prior to final billing generation.
errors.config_step: Configure Down Payment Clearing in Billing Item Category Customizing
errors.verify: Create final billing document via VF01; verify that the billing document includes the negative down payment clearing line item offsetting the total value.
errors.prevent: Train billing clerks on standard clearing procedures before executing final invoice generation for milestone-billed orders.
